notifications.title: First Disaster Desk long video is in the queue: the Hyatt walkway collapse
notifications.detail: L-20261121-42 'The Hyatt Walkway Collapse: One Phone Call Doubled the Load' (8:34) was made by Studio today for the next long slot (Sunday 22:47 IST). It is the full version of the internal sample, rebuilt after your review: a detailed 3D atrium (textured floor, trusses, tables, lit walkways), the joint as brushed steel in cutaway, a 3D failure shot, and diagrams as short inserts. Facts come from the NBS report and two ASCE articles; the fact reviewer passed it on the second round. The channel has no Shorts yet, so there is no Short to link as its 'related video'. The long topic feed had only this one topic: Scout runs Mon and Thu, so Tuesday's Studio run will have nothing new unless Scout adds topics first.
notifications.fix: 1. Watch it on the dashboard before Sunday 22:47 IST; mark it stale if the look or pace isn't right. 2. Thumbnail: Studio picked A ('Twice the weight', 3D walkway with the red joint); B (drawn vs built) and C are alternatives. After it publishes you can run YouTube's Test & Compare with thumbnail.png, thumbnail-b.png and thumbnail-c.png. 3. If you want a Tuesday long video, have Scout add topics (or run it once by hand) before Tuesday 10:20 IST.
